description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractConditionHeaderCheckingCommandStrategy that extends a command strategy. It is responsible for checking conditional (HTTP) headers based on an entity's current eTag value within a persistent actors framework, likely used for handling commands with preconditions in a distributed or persistent system.

classes.name: AbstractConditionHeaderCheckingCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class that provides the mechanism to check conditional HTTP headers (like If-Match and If-None-Match) against an entity's current eTag value before executing commands. It ensures preconditions are met and handles validation failures.

methods.name: AbstractConditionHeaderCheckingCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with a specific command class it can handle.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses implement to provide a ConditionalHeadersValidator used for header validation.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Validates the conditional headers using the validator, logs the process, and either returns an error result if validation fails or proceeds with the command processing.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if the strategy is applicable for the given command and entity, based on entity ID matching.
